item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 20/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over southern China today and tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning with rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the monsoon moderating gradually, temperatures will rise further over Guangdong over the weekend. It will be rather warm during the day. Winds are expected to be weak over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. It will be hot during the day and visibility will be relatively low.
